newsitem.title: USA: Hair color maker Carson Inc plans $60 mln IPO. [CORRECTED 19:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hair color maker Carson Inc plans $60 mln IPO. [CORRECTED 19:05 GMT]

text.p: Carson Inc, which makes hair color and other hair care products for African-Americans, plans to raise about $60 million in its planned initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing.

Merrill Lynch will lead-manage the offering of 4.19 million shares to price in a range of $14 to $16. Of the total number of shares, 2.48 million will be offered by Carson and 1.7 million will be offered by selling shareholders.

Carson's fiscal 1996 sales grew 17.5 percent to $68.3 million from $58.1 million. Its 1996 operating income grew to $12.0 million from $8.2 million in 1995, (corrects from "to $8.2 million from $12.0 million").
